One photo is enough. For a closer likeness, pick 2 or 3 photos. Everyone who should be in the stickers (max. 2) must be in the main photo.
If you pick more than 1 photo, they must all show the SAME outfit (clothes, hijab, accessories).
Pick at least 1 photo to continue.
1 photo picked. Add photo 2 or 3 for a closer likeness (optional).
2 photos picked. Add 1 more for the closest likeness (optional).
Faces were detected automatically. Tap the box on a face to choose who becomes a sticker (max. 2).
No face found. Go back and use a main photo where the face is clearly visible.
There are %1$d faces. Pick up to 2.
Tap the face to turn into stickers.
The stickers will show 2 people: the blue one (left) and the orange one (right).
The other photos are used as extra references for a closer likeness.
You can make 3 to 10 stickers. They\'re all drawn in 1 AI image, so the cost is the same.
The AI picks a different pose and expression for each sticker. Want ready-made captions and poses? Tap 🎁 Theme packs.
%1$d ready-made packs. Tap one to fill the captions and poses of your %2$d stickers, then edit them if you like.

Usually 15–60 seconds. You can leave the app — you\'ll get a notification when the stickers are ready.

Your sticker packs. Tap a pack to rename it, delete stickers, or add it to WhatsApp again (max. %1$d stickers per pack).
Create stickers and tap \"Add to WhatsApp\" — your packs will show up here.
